notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
1. Added a new powerful AI.

2. The AI logic has been optimized, and now the AI is more active.

3. The generation logic of procedural levels has been updated. There are no longer levels with super long paths, and there are now difficult new levels with multiple AIs in a single room. The overall game pace has been greatly improved.

4. Updated UI.
